product_metadata.title: Exclusivo Mezcla 100% Cotton Oversized 35"x70" Cabana Stripe Beach Towel, Super Absorbent Soft Plush Pool Towel, Bath Towel (Yellow)
features: Cotton Material- Made of 420 GSM of cotton (grams per square meter), this beach towel is much softer and more absorbent than normal ones.
Eye Catching- Our cotton beach towel features Retro style, cabana stripes in bright color are printed on the one side, simple but classic.

Super Cozy- Made of 100% cotton for Maximum softness, absorbency and durability. Cotton Beach Towels with high color fastness soaks up moisture on your skin while wrapping you with the feeling of warmth and comfort.

Easy Care- Machine wash in cold on gentle cycle, tumble dry on low. Please wash it alone or with other towels in similar colors. Thanks to its cotton fabric, there is no lints or loose threads on the towel after washing.

Widely Used- This beach towel could be used as a beach blanket, pool towel, bath towel or even a picnic blanket- more as you please. Whether for a seaside vocation, outdoor camping, swimming or yoga & gym fitness. The perfect weight and size of the towel (35x70 Inch) for the entire family to use. These generously sized towels are great for use at the beach, by the pool or at home in the bathroom.
